description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pembrolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, with carboplatin and paclitaxel as an option for untreated metastatic squamous non-small-cell lung cancer in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 with a tumour proportion score of 0% to 49%, or whose tumours express PD-L1 with a tumour proportion score of 50% or more and who need urgent clinical intervention. Treatment is stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment or earlier if disease progresses. Pembrolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
